Frequently Asked Questions

What to know before starting your custom apparel order.

Is there a minimum order?

Our minimum order is one item. We also welcome business, event, and group orders.

How long does an order take?

Typically 7–10 business days after artwork approval and payment. Your quote confirms timing based on the garments, artwork, quantity, and availability.

Do you offer free delivery?

Yes. We offer free local delivery throughout Citrus and Hernando counties, with delivery arranged directly with you.

Can I use my own logo or artwork?

Yes. Email your artwork to hello@citruscustomapparel.com. Vector files or high-resolution images are helpful. We’ll review suitability before production.

How much does printing cost?

Pricing depends on garment choice, quantity, decoration method, artwork, and print locations. Request a quote for your specific project.

Can I see the design before printing?

We’ll provide an artwork proof for your approval before production.

Do you accept rush orders?

Contact us with your exact deadline. We’ll confirm whether it is possible before you place an order.

Can I visit a shop?

We coordinate orders online and by email and offer local delivery. We do not advertise a public walk-in storefront.

Let’s make something yours.
